title: Lifecycle revalidation publication spends ~70% of its StateInner hold in per-row changed-run projection
outcome: Publishing the changed rows of one batched evidence persistence (persist_test_run_evidence_batch_with_compaction_locked, the TestRunIdentityIndex changed_row pass) no longer costs tens of microseconds per changed row under StateInner, so a lifecycle revalidation that changes many rows holds the lock for time dominated by the rows' own updates, not their run-summary projection.
acceptance: Lifecycle revalidation publication spends ~70% of its StateInner hold in per-row changed-run projection is done
